# ClickBench — URL Hash IN Clause

```{tags} reference, query-template, clickbench
```

> [ClickBench](../../clickbench.md) benchmark · [all ClickBench queries](index.md)

URLHash + EventDate with IN clause filter and OFFSET 100

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  URLHash,
  EventDate,
  COUNT(*) AS PageViews
FROM hits
WHERE
  CounterID = 62
  AND EventDate >= '2013-07-01'
  AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31'
  AND IsRefresh = 0
  AND TraficSourceID IN (-1, 6)
  AND RefererHash = 3594120000172545465
GROUP BY
  URLHash,
  EventDate
ORDER BY
  PageViews DESC
LIMIT 10
OFFSET 100
```
